results.title: Deep Learning for 3D Human Pose Estimation and Mesh Recovery
results.content: To the best of our knowledge, this survey is arguably the first to comprehensively cover deep learning methods for 3D human pose estimation, including both single-person and multi-person approaches, as well as human mesh recovery, encompassing methods based on explicit models and implicit representations.
